routes.name: EU Blue Card (highly qualified worker)
routes.summary: Residence permit for highly qualified workers with a Luxembourg job contract of at least 6 months. Needs a gross salary of at least EUR 65,652 per year.

income.note: Gross annual salary, the stated average gross annual salary

eligibility.education: Diplomas or professional qualifications proving the high qualification needed for the job
other: Employment contract of at least 6 months, signed by both sides
CV and criminal record extract or sworn affidavit

stay.note: 4 years, or contract length plus 3 months if the contract is shorter.

steps: Get a temporary authorisation to stay (90 days) before travel
Get a type D visa if your nationality needs one
Apply for the residence permit within 3 months of arriving
routes.processing: Temporary authorisation normally takes up to 3 months. No decision in that time counts as rejected.

routes.name: Long-term resident (EU)
routes.summary: Permit for non-EU nationals after 5 years of lawful, uninterrupted residence. You need stable, regular income and no social welfare.

other: At least 5 years of uninterrupted lawful residence
Stable and sufficient resources over the 5 years, compared with the unskilled social minimum wage
Blue Card holders can qualify after 5 years in the EU with the last 2 in Luxembourg

stay.note: Withdrawn after 12 months outside the EU (24 for former Blue Card holders) or 6 years outside Luxembourg.

routes.name: Naturalisation
routes.summary: Adults who lived legally in Luxembourg for at least 5 years can apply. You need a Luxembourgish language test certificate and the Vivre ensemble course or test.

eligibility.language: Luxembourgish, proven by a language test certificate (level not stated on the page)
other: At least 5 years of legal residence, with the year right before applying uninterrupted
Complete the Vivre ensemble au Grand-Duche de Luxembourg course or pass its test

citizenship.note: Dual citizenship rules not stated on this page.

routes.processing: The Minister of Justice must decide within 8 months of the application.
